title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 7-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$7$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining $$6$$ parts are used for training.

title: Calculating Total Model Fits
text: Milena tests $$2$$ values of λ and $$5$$ values of ρ. For each combination of λ and ρ, she performs 7-fold cross-validation.

title: Determine the Number of Model Fits
text: Calculate the total number of model fits by multiplying the number of λ values, ρ values, and the number of folds.

title: Determine the Usage of Each Data Point
text: Each data point is used in the training set for $$6$$ out of the $$7$$ folds. Multiply this by the total number of model fits.

title: Final Calculation
text: Each data point is used in the training set $$6$$ times per fold. Multiply this by the total number of model fits to find the total usage of each data point.
